dedupe_keys.name: waste to energy plant in spain social cost benefit analysis of a barcelona incineration plant springer chapter 2022

description: This case study, a Springer book chapter from 2022 with an open copy in the UNIR repository, appraises a waste-to-energy incineration plant in Barcelona with a social cost-benefit analysis. The abstract read on 2026-09-28 says the plant treats more than 350,000 tonnes of municipal solid waste a year and generates more than 180,000 MWh of electricity and 110,000 tonnes of steam, and that the analysis identifies and monetises positive and negative impacts across the three pillars of sustainability, including energy sales, reduced landfill disposal, lower greenhouse gas emissions and dioxin emissions; the results show the plant is profitable from a private point of view (benefit ratio 15.97) and from an economic, environmental and social perspective (37.48). Coverage is one plant in Barcelona. Access is free through the open repository copy; its licence was not read. Caveats: the valuation choices drive the ratios, and plant data come from the authors' sources, not an operator dataset. It supports investment appraisal of waste and energy infrastructure, as a template for valuing impacts of similar plants. Related record: data-unep-global-waste-management-outlook-2024 gives the global waste context.
